sloka: खरोष्ट्राश्वतरा राजन्भिन्न्रोमाः स्रवन्ति च ।न स्वभावेऽवतिष्ठन्ते विधानैरपि चिन्तताः ॥६-१०-१८॥।।
transliteration: kharoṣṭrāśvatarā rājanbhinnromāḥ sravanti ca ।na svabhāve'vatiṣṭhante vidhānairapi cintatāḥ ॥6-10-18॥।।

translations.english: "O King the donkeys and camels have shed their body hair and are crying. Even though they are treated for it in different ways they are not getting to be in normal natural form."
translations.hindi: हे राजन्‌ ! गधों, उटों खचरों के रोंगटे गिर गए हैं और वे आँसू बहाया करते हैं । चिकित्सा करने पर भी वे प्रकृतिस्थ नहों होते
